translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Abram untaloi buda tomahaja aka umpesäkäi Lot
Pissam wattu, deem appa' tomahaja umpamesa buku, isanga Amrafel tomahajanna Sinear, Ariokh tomahajanna Elasar, Kedorlaomer tomahajanna Elam, anna Tideal tomahajanna Goyim;
Umbundu' lima tomahaja senga' isanga ia Bera tomahajanna Sodom, Birsya tomahajanna Gomora, Syinab tomahajanna Adma, Syemeber tomahajanna Zeboim, anna tomahaja dio mai Bela battu diua Zoar.
Padam too duka' umpamesa kalena uhhempum sohodadunna dio lembäna Sidim, indo disangaim temo Le'bo' Mässi'.
Sapulo duam taunna nadakka' bata' ulunna Kedorlaomer tomahajanna Elam sapo' tamai kasapulo tallunna taunna, umpamesam buku anna mangngebai.

Tappana mentama kasapulo appa'na taunna, ma'mesa pole oom Kedorlaomer sola indo tallu solana tomahaja anna sohodadunna, lambi' untaloi to Refaim dio Asyterot-Karnaim, to Zuzim dio Ham, to Emim dio Syawe Kiryataim,
anna to Hori yabo ongeam tipatanetena isanga Seir sule lako El-Paran bihinna pohiallasam.
Puhai ia too, ma'pasuleim lu lako En-Mispat, indo disangaim temo Kadesy, anna umpentaloi duka' ingganna to Amalek anna to Amori to tohho dio Hazezon-Tamar.
Pissananna indo lima tomahaja ingngena', tomahajanna Sodom, Gomora, Adma, Zeboim anna Bela (battu diua Zoar), umpamesa buku anna mengngebai dio lembä Sidim.
Umbali Kedorlaomer, tomahajanna Elam, Tideal, tomahajanna Goyim, Amrafel tomahajanna Sinear, anna Ariokh, tomahajanna Elasar. Dadi lima tomahaja mueba appa' tomahaja.

Indo dio lembä Sidim naongei buda hano ter. Pissananna indo tomahajanna Sodom anna Gomora napeä lalanna anna lahii umpellei pa'bundusam, sapo' buda hi mate aka lämmä' dokko indo hano ter. Anna indo malannapi lahi, lu längänni tipatanetena.

Indo appa' tomahaja umpamesa buku ingngena', patalo ia, sampe ingganna aka-aka dio Sodom anna Gomora susi membaham-bahanna teem mengkinandena, napamuhu asam lao sola taunna. Moi duka' Lot indo änä' uhena Abram dipahhim toi sola ingganna kullena, aka tohho dio duka' Sodom.

Iya sule siaham mesa to malahi dio mai pa'bundusam umpa'tulasam Abram diona indo kaha-kaha puha dadi. Indo Abram mesa to Ibrani tohho dio sikahuku' too' kaju tumalumbunna Mamre mesa to Amori. Indo Mamre sola solasubunna isanga Eskol anna Aner sangngim sihondä penaba Abram.
Tappana naissam Abram naua: “Disakka änä' uheku,” iya mengkalao siaham umpasola änä' isalinna to mateha' ma'bundu', tallu hatu' sapulo kahua tau budanna, anna le'ba'i muula' balinna sule lako Dan.
Bengii, umbahe-bahem taunna Abram dio Dan anna mane ma'bundu'. Iya umpahissim lium balinna sule lako Hoba tandai lakona Damsyik.
Sampe naala asam sule Abram indo ingganna kulle dipamuhu, duka' Lot indo änä' uhena, sola ingganna kullena anna ingganna baine sola tau senga'.
Melkisedek umpa'lambeam Abram
Puhai untaloi Kedorlaomer sola solana, ma'pasulem Abram. Iya le'ba'um tomahajanna Sodom natammui lako lembäna Syawe, si biasa diuaam Lembäna Tomahaja.
Susi duka' Melkisedek tomahajanna Salem mesa sandona Puang Allataala To handam matande le'ba' umbabaam hoti sola anggur Abram.
Anna indo Melkisedek umpa'lambeam Abram naua:

content.text: “La natamba' dako too Puang Allataala To handam matande To umpadadi langi' anna lino.
Anna dipa'kasallei sanganna Puang Allataala To handam matande aka puhangko nabeem kapataloam.”

content: Iya naalam Abram indo baham-baham pamuhunna Kedorlaomer anna napehumalasanni bahe sapulona nabeem Melkisedek.
Iya ma'kadam ia tomahajanna Sodom lako Abram naua: “Ala asammi tiko itim membaham-bahanna, sapo' kela mala anna umbeem asannä' ia sule ingganna hupataungku.”
Sapo' natimba' Abram naua: “Ma'pindaä' dio olona Puang Allataala DEBATAngku To handam matande, anna To umpadadi langi' anna lino,
moi la dahum suppi tala kualai kullemu dapaka ia la baham-baham senga'. Aka indana muuai: ‘Kao hi to kao anna to makakai Abram.’
Dadi, tä' kao deem la kuala. Tengkanammi ia indo puhannam naande änä'-änä'ku. Sapo' lu lakona solaku Aner, Eskol, anna Mamre, päbäi mammi ia naala tabana.”
